log_path.description: Full path to the squid access.log file that squidview will monitor.

refresh_interval.description: Time in seconds between each refresh of the log display in the ncurses UI.

history_lines.description: Maximum number of log lines to keep in the local history buffer for scrolling.

color_theme.description: Color theme applied to the ncurses interface (e.g., dark, light).

sort_ascending.description: If true, sorts log entries by timestamp in ascending order; if false, descending.

status_codes_filter.description: List of HTTP status codes to include in the view. Empty list means no filtering.

run_user.description: System user to switch to for reading the log file if permissions require it.
